description: This file defines the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system's maintenance module. The class implements a strategy for purging records by replacing certain field values with formatted replacements, based on external formatting strategies.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for purging database records by replacing specific fields with formatted values, within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Finds entities matching the given employee number and processes each to replace field values.

methods.name: purgeRecord
methods.description: Replaces specified fields in an entity with formatted values using defined replace strategies, then persists the changes.

methods.name: getReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns a formatting strategy instance based on a string identifier.
